# Getting Started

Spindle is a local-first Markdown notebook.

## Opening a vault

Pick **Open a vault** and choose any folder. Spindle treats a folder of
plain `.md` files as a vault.

## Shortcuts

- `Cmd+O` — quick switcher
- `Cmd+P` — command palette
- `Cmd+Shift+F` — search
- `Cmd+G` — graph view
- `Cmd+D` — today's daily note
- `Cmd+E` — toggle source / preview
- `Cmd+N` — new note

See [[Welcome]] and [[Projects]] for more.
